title: Celestial Paw Portrait
description: A surreal stained-glass style portrait of a woman's face split between a black and white moon-like left side and a vibrant orange right side with flowing hair, enclosed within a large ornate paw print. The composition features fleur-de-lis patterns, floral motifs, and floating broken shards against a cracked black background, with stylized flowers and plants at the bottom.
prompt: A surreal symbolic artwork featuring a woman's face split between black and white and vibrant orange, enclosed inside an ornate glowing paw print. The design incorporates fleur-de-lis, floral patterns, and flowing hair. Floating broken shards and paw prints surround the central motif against a cracked dark background. Stylized flowers and plants grow from the bottom of the frame in a stained glass aesthetic with bold outlines.
